Final categorization: OK  
(Justification: The paper presents original research focused on national-scale future land-use and land-cover (LULC) prediction for Brazil. It explicitly models the entire country using a spatially explicit framework (10 km × 10 km grid), implements three distinct future scenarios aligned with SSP/RCP combinations (SSP1/RCP1.9, SSP2/RCP4.5, SSP3/RCP7.0), and quantitatively compares projected changes across six LULC classes. The modeling approach integrates biophysical, socioeconomic, and institutional drivers per biome, uses quantitative demand projections from IMAGE, and includes validation against observed data with reported accuracy metrics (e.g., 84.44% average spatial fit, omission/commission errors). Outputs include mapped LULC projections to 2050 in NetCDF format. All core inclusion criteria are met, and no exclusion criteria apply.)
